title: Read live acceptance criteria during and after task preparation
description: Read-only. Select an authenticated gateway profile, owned FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_TAB, FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_RUN_ID, FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_OUTPUT and FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_PHASE=pre-task, task, pre-worker, no-watch, fresh, preparing or read-failure. Run once while a naturally scheduled run is writing its task and again after. The no-watch phase accepts any run phase and retained progress. The fresh phase requires a created run without a task; preparing requires a Preparing run without a ledger. For deterministic setup, start operation-log-proof-fixture.mjs with ACCEPTANCE_ABSENCE_PROOF=1 and ACCEPTANCE_LEDGER_ERROR_PROOF=1 and use its absenceRuns IDs. The pre-worker phase requires a naturally Preparing run with no verified watch. For read-failure, start operation-log-proof-fixture.mjs with ACCEPTANCE_LEDGER_ERROR_PROOF=1, log in with operation-log-proof and select ledger-error-cli for the proof. The visible red text must match the backend ledger error. No run mutation or injected UI state.

read-criteria.intent: Read the actual run through authenticated RPC and its connected Command Center panel. Prove one-level criterion text and no false zero tally; before the task, show registered criteria or quiet preparation without a ledger error.
